slug: 2025-03-21 Burkina Faso launches SYC@D land cadastre platform

facts.fact: The Ministry of Economy and Finance says it launched SYC@D, the integrated cadastre and domain management system, on 21 March 2025 at sif.bf to process and issue land-occupation titles.
The Ministry of Economy and Finance says users can apply for plot allocation, obtain a cadastral extract and receive provisional and definitive transfer orders online through SYC@D.
